class Receive {
  async complete(pending: { id: string }): Promise<void> {
    const outcome = { kind: "refused" as string };
    const state = "unspent";
    if (outcome.kind === "refused" && state === "unspent") {
      await (await this.useStore()).abort(pending.id);
      throw new Error("bad_solution");
    }
    throw new Error("store_unavailable");
  }
  async useStore(): Promise<{ abort(id: string): Promise<void> }> {
    return { async abort() {} };
  }
}
